info.title: Cortana AI Public API
info.description: The Cortana AI Public API enables programmatic access to contacts, conversations, messages, agents, appointments, conversions, tracking sessions, tags, custom fields, financial data (Stripe, Shopify, Whop), attribution analytics, voice call logs/transcripts, meeting data, and agency-level business creation. Most endpoints are scoped to a business (`/api/v1/businesses/{businessId}/...`); creating a new business uses `POST /api/v1/businesses`, and **agency business templates** (same as *Copy as template* in the app) are listed with `GET /api/v1/businesses/templates` for use as `templateId` on create. All endpoints require Bearer token authentication.

tags.name: Messages
tags.description: Send and list messages within conversations

tags.name: Form Submissions
tags.description: Read booking-form submissions (leads) — the answers visitors submit plus attribution

tags.name: Stripe
tags.description: Stripe financial data — payments, subscriptions, customers, metrics, products

tags.name: Embedded Checkouts
tags.description: Create and manage embeddable Cortana checkouts, and create Stripe products on the fly.

tags.name: Shopify
tags.description: Shopify e-commerce data — orders, customers, products, analytics, abandoned carts

tags.name: Attribution
tags.description: Attribution analytics — full attribution table, distinct UTM values, column presets, and contacts ranked by lifetime value

tags.name: Meetings
tags.description: Fathom meeting metadata, structured fields, transcripts, and aggregated insights

tags.name: Businesses
tags.description: Create businesses and list agency business templates (programmatic onboarding)

post.description:
Creates a new business under the API key owner's agency (same as adding a business in the Control Centre), including defaults or an optional agency template.

**Authentication:** Bearer API key with the **`businesses:write`** scope. This scope is not included in the default *Chrome Extension* preset — use *Agency / onboarding automation* or add **Businesses → Write** when generating the key.

**Who may call:** The key must belong to an **agency owner**, **superuser**, or **manager with Admin** access. Non-superusers need an **active plan**.

**Templates:** To copy configuration from an agency template created in the UI (*Copy as template*), call **`GET /api/v1/businesses/templates`**, pick an `id`, and pass it as **`templateId`** in this request body.

**After success:** Use the returned `id` as `{businessId}` on routes such as `GET /api/v1/businesses/{businessId}/contacts`.

403.description: Insufficient scope, wrong role, inactive plan, or cannot resolve agency

get.description:
Returns agency **business templates** (the same assets you save with *Copy as template* in the Control Centre). Use a template **`id`** as **`templateId`** on `POST /api/v1/businesses`.

**Privacy:** Pass **`omitSource=true`** to omit `sourceBusinessId` and `sourceBusinessName` when you do not want API consumers to see which client business a template was copied from.

**Authentication:** Bearer API key with the **`businesses:write`** scope (same as create business).

**Who may call:** Same rules as create business — **agency owner**, **superuser**, or **manager with Admin**; non-superusers need an **active plan**.

parameters.name: omitSource
parameters.description: When `true` (or `1` / `yes`), each item omits `sourceBusinessId` and `sourceBusinessName` so the response does not reveal the originating client business.

200.description: Templates for the API key owner's agency

403.description: Insufficient scope, wrong role, inactive plan, or cannot resolve agency

parameters.name: eventTypeId
parameters.description: Filter by event type (which booking form)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status (PARTIAL = started, SUBMITTED = completed form, BOOKED = booked a slot)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of date range (ISO 8601), filters by createdAt

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of date range (ISO 8601), filters by createdAt

post.description: Creates a custom conversion for the business. Every business also has the standard conversions seeded, listed by GET; they are created inactive, so activate one with PATCH before pointing traffic at its sources.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the conversion, its sources and every conversion entry under it (with an audit record for each entry). When the conversion holds entries the call answers 409 with the count until you re-send it with confirmEntryCount equal to that count. Refund conversions managed by the system answer 403; they are removed with the conversion they belong to.

parameters.name: confirmEntryCount
parameters.description: Required when the conversion holds entries: the exact number of entries you expect to delete, as returned by the 409.

get.summary: List sources for a conversion config

post.description: Creates a source under the conversion. sourceType selects the shape: WEBHOOK (default) returns a webhookUrl to POST payloads to; STRIPE_WEBHOOK, TYPEFORM_WEBHOOK and GHL_WEBHOOK are backed by the business's connected integration. Use GET .../source-options/{integration} to discover ids.

patch.description: Updates a source. The stored sourceType decides which fields are accepted.

delete.description: Removes the source. Conversion entries it created are kept and stay counted under their conversion; they are detached from the removed source.

get.summary: Get source options for an integration
get.description: What you can pass to POST .../sources for a connected integration: the event catalogue each accepts and, where a business can have several, the connections to choose between. Data comes from the mirrored tables; refresh=true re-syncs from the integration first (typeform, ghl, close).

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Re-sync from the integration before answering (typeform, ghl, tally).

parameters.name: ghlConnectionId
parameters.description: ghl with refresh=true: sync only this sub-account.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: clickfunnels: also list this workspace connection's products, pipelines (with stages) and funnels, fetched live from ClickFunnels (502 if it refuses).

get.description: Paginated list of Stripe payments with date range, status, recurring, and customer filters.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by payment status (e.g., succeeded, failed, refunded)

parameters.name: status

get.description: Returns daily or monthly SaaS metrics: MRR, ARR, churn rates, retention, ARPU, LTV, trial conversions, revenue breakdowns by product, and 40+ more fields. Required: from and to date range.

parameters.name: stripeAccountId
parameters.description: Filter by specific Stripe account (for multi-account setups)

get.description: Every embedded-checkout configuration for the business, each with live stats and a ready-to-paste embed snippet. Requires the embedded_checkouts:read scope.

post.description: Create an embedded-checkout configuration from synced Stripe prices. The response includes the embed snippet and a livemode flag so you know whether it can take real payments. The mode (subscription or one-time) is derived server-side from the prices. The business must already have a tracking pixel, otherwise the call returns 409. Requires the embedded_checkouts:write scope.

201.description: Embedded checkout created. data includes the embed snippet, the livemode flag, and a manageUrl deep link.

409.description: The business has no tracking pixel yet, so an embed snippet cannot be built. Create one under Ad Tracking, Tracking Pixels, then retry.

get.description: Retrieve a single embedded-checkout configuration, including its live stats and embed snippet. Requires the embedded_checkouts:read scope.

patch.description: Merge-patch an embedded checkout: fields you omit stay as they are, fields you send as null are cleared. Send isActive to pause or resume. The merged configuration is re-validated against Stripe. Requires the embedded_checkouts:write scope.

delete.description: Turn an embedded checkout OFF. This is a validation-free kill switch: it always works, even when the underlying prices or Stripe are in a state that would fail validation. The configuration is kept, just deactivated, so it can be turned back on with PATCH. Requires the embedded_checkouts:write scope.

post.description: Create a product and one or more prices on a connected Stripe account, then sync them into Cortana so they can be used in an embedded checkout. Amounts are in DOLLARS (49.99, not 4999). The response livemode flag tells you whether the product was created on a live or test account. Requires the stripe:write scope.

201.description: Product and prices created and synced

get.description: Product catalog with pricing tiers. Each product includes its price list.

200.description: Paginated list of products with prices

get.description: Returns the full attribution table grouped by source, campaign, medium, or ad. Each row includes page views, unique visitors, leads, ad spend, conversions by event type, revenue, ROAS, and ROI. The response also includes a daily summary time series and the filters that were applied. Required: startDate and endDate.

parameters.name: endDate

parameters.name: to

get.description: Returns Fathom meeting data. A single endpoint with four modes selected via the `mode` query parameter: `list` (default — meeting metadata), `get` (a single meeting with structured fields, requires `meetingId`), `insights` (aggregated breakdown across all matching meetings), and `transcript` (full transcript for one meeting, requires `meetingId`). The response shape depends on the selected mode.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Which view of the meetings data to return

parameters.name: meetingId
parameters.description: Meeting ID — required when mode is get or transcript

parameters.name: callTypeId
parameters.description: Filter meetings by call type ID

parameters.name: salesRepEmail
parameters.description: Filter meetings by the email of the sales rep who recorded them

parameters.name: isStructured
parameters.description: Filter by whether the meeting has structured fields extracted

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Only include meetings on or after this date (ISO 8601)

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: Only include meetings on or before this date (ISO 8601)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of meetings to return (list mode)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor — the meeting ID to start after (list mode)

200.description: Meeting data. Shape depends on the mode: list returns data plus a pagination cursor; get returns a single meeting; insights returns an aggregated breakdown; transcript returns the full transcript.

data.description: An array of meetings (list mode) or a single object (get, insights, transcript modes)

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null if there are no more results

400.description: Validation error (e.g. missing meetingId for mode=get or mode=transcript)

413.description: Transcript exceeds the 2 MB response limit

BearerAuth.description: API key prefixed with `sk-ak-`. Pass as `Authorization: Bearer sk-ak-...`

EmbeddedCheckout.description: An embedded-checkout configuration. mode is derived server-side from the prices. snippet is the code to paste into a page; it is null until the business has a tracking pixel. livemode is null when the connected account's mode is unknown.

stats.description: Live performance stats. Present on reads (GET), omitted on create and update responses.

snippet.description: The embed code to paste into a page.

manageUrl.description: Deep link to manage this checkout in Cortana. Present on the create response only.

stripeAccountId.description: A connected Stripe account owned by this business.

lineItems.description: The prices to charge. Every price must be a synced, active price of a product this business owns on the chosen account. Any recurring price makes the whole checkout a subscription.

optionalItems.description: Order bumps the buyer can add. A recurring bump is only allowed on a subscription checkout.

trialPeriodDays.description: Free-trial length. Requires a subscription (recurring) price.

introSwitchPriceId.description: Intro offer: after the first billing period, move the subscription to this recurring price (same Stripe account and currency). lineItems must hold exactly one recurring price. Cannot be combined with trialPeriodDays.

promotionCodeId.description: A pre-applied Stripe promotion code, verified live against the account at save. Mutually exclusive with allowPromotionCodes.

allowPromotionCodes.description: Show a promo-code field at checkout. Mutually exclusive with promotionCodeId.

termsText.description: Terms-of-service acceptance text. When set, the account must have a Terms of Service URL; this is proven with a live dry run at save.

returnUrl.description: http(s) URL the buyer returns to after payment.

UpdateEmbeddedCheckout.description: Merge-patch: every field is optional. Omitted fields keep their current value; a field sent as null is cleared. Send at least one field.

introSwitchPriceId.description: Intro offer switch price. null clears it.

isActive.description: Set false to pause, true to resume.

currency.description: Defaults to the account currency when omitted.

id.description: Use as businessId on other API routes

sourceBusinessId.description: Originating business UUID when the template was created from *Copy as template*. Omitted when `omitSource=true`.

sourceBusinessName.description: Originating business display name. Omitted when `omitSource=true`.

businessOwnership.description:
Who owns this business — same as the in-app **Who owns this business?** control.

| Value | Meaning |
|-------|--------|
| `us` | Your agency (in the app this row shows your **company name** or **Us** / Cortana) |
| `client` | **Client / someone else** |

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier. Same complete set and sort order as **Create business** in the app (searchable combobox by region name).

managedPlan.description: Request SaaS/managed plan; requires Stripe Connect on the agency when true

manageBilling.description: When not using managed SaaS flow, sets initial managed billing flag (stored as managedBilling)

templateId.description: Optional agency template to copy (same as *Copy as template* in the app). List IDs with `GET /api/v1/businesses/templates`.

CreateContact.description: At least one of email, phone, or firstName is required.

FormSubmission.description: A booking-form submission (BookingLead) — a form fill at any stage.

eventTypeId.description: The event type (booking form) this submission belongs to

status.description: PARTIAL = started, SUBMITTED = completed form, BOOKED = booked a slot

formData.description: The answers the visitor submitted, keyed by question label

convertedToAppointmentId.description: The appointment id if this submission booked

name.description: Internal key, lower-case with underscores. Unique per business.

displayName.description: The label shown in the dashboard.

isActive.description: When false the conversion accepts webhooks but creates no contacts or conversions.

isStandard.description: True for the conversions seeded on every new business.

trackNewOnly.description: Count a contact once for this conversion, not every time it fires.

revenueCategory.description: CASH_COLLECTED counts toward cash collected; LTV_ONLY counts toward lifetime value only.

sourceType.description: WEBHOOK, STRIPE_WEBHOOK, TYPEFORM_WEBHOOK, GHL_WEBHOOK, CLOSE_WEBHOOK, PAYPAL_WEBHOOK, WHOP_WEBHOOK, FANBASIS_WEBHOOK, CALENDLY_WEBHOOK, CAL_COM_WEBHOOK, FATHOM_WEBHOOK, HUBSPOT_WEBHOOK, SALESFORCE_WEBHOOK, ICLOSED_WEBHOOK, SHOPIER, SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK, SHOPIFY_PIXEL, WOOCOMMERCE_WEBHOOK, WOOCOMMERCE_PIXEL, CLICKFUNNELS_WEBHOOK, TALLY_WEBHOOK, CALLRAIL_WEBHOOK, or another type created from the dashboard. Kajabi sources are WEBHOOK rows.

fieldMappings.description: The stored configuration for this source. For WEBHOOK sources this is the field mapping; for integration sources it holds the event and filters.

webhookUrl.description: Where to POST payloads for WEBHOOK sources. Null for integration sources, which receive data through their own connection.

CreateSource.description: Pick the shape by sourceType. WEBHOOK (the default) is a URL you POST to; every other type is backed by the business's connected integration. Use GET .../source-options/{integration} to discover the events and connections each accepts.

UpdateSource.description: The stored sourceType decides which fields are accepted; fields for another type are a 400. At least one field is required.

CreateEntry.description:
Create a conversion entry. Two modes:

**Direct mode:** Pass eventValue, currency, expense directly.

**Mapped mode:** Pass a `data` object with raw key-value pairs. The source's fieldMappings (configured in the dashboard) automatically maps incoming keys to:
- Entry fields (eventValue, currency, expense, occurredAt)
- Contact fields (email, phone, firstName, lastName, etc.)
- Custom fields (any custom field key defined for the business)

Both modes can be combined — direct values are used as fallbacks if mapping doesn't produce a value.

sourceId.description: The conversion source to send the entry to

contactId.description: The contact this conversion belongs to

eventValue.description: Direct conversion value (used when not using field mappings)

occurredAt.description: When the conversion occurred (defaults to now)

data.description: Raw data object with key-value pairs. Keys are your source-side field names (e.g., 'order_total', 'customer_email'). The source's fieldMappings translates these to internal fields automatically.

name.description: Becomes the internal key (lower-cased, spaces to underscores, at most 50 characters after normalising) and, unless displayName is given, the label. A duplicate key is a 409.

revenueCategory.description: CASH_COLLECTED counts toward cash collected; LTV_ONLY counts toward lifetime value only.

isActive.description: Defaults to true so a conversion created by an automation receives data immediately.

example.name: Booked Call
example.description: Discovery call booked from any sub-account

UpdateConversionConfig.description: Merge patch: omitted fields are left unchanged. At least one field is required.

icon.description: Custom conversions only; a standard conversion answers 400.

valueRequired.description: Custom conversions only; a standard conversion answers 400.

isActive.description: Also applied to every source under the conversion, as the dashboard toggle does. Standard conversions are seeded inactive: activate one before pointing traffic at its sources.

revenueCategory.description: CASH_COLLECTED counts toward cash collected; LTV_ONLY counts toward lifetime value only.

oneOf.description: Keys are paths into your payload (dot notation, for example contact.email). Values are the target field: one of email, firstName, lastName, name, phone, company, address, city, state, country, timezone, website, eventValue, revenue, currency, orderId, externalId, expense, occurredAt, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_ad, utm_ad_id, utm_content, utm_term, fbclid, gclid; do_nothing to keep a field visible but ignored; or custom_<customFieldId> for a custom field that belongs to this business. Any other value is a 400 that names it.
oneOf.title: Simple mapping

mappings.description: Keys are paths into your payload (dot notation, for example contact.email). Values are the target field: one of email, firstName, lastName, name, phone, company, address, city, state, country, timezone, website, eventValue, revenue, currency, orderId, externalId, expense, occurredAt, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_ad, utm_ad_id, utm_content, utm_term, fbclid, gclid; do_nothing to keep a field visible but ignored; or custom_<customFieldId> for a custom field that belongs to this business. Any other value is a 400 that names it.

revenueCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code applied when the payload carries no currency.

mode.description: Direct mode: your payload already uses the target field names above (email, phone, utm_source, revenue, and so on), so no mapping is needed. Mutually exclusive with fieldMappings. Without either, the source stores payloads for later mapping and creates nothing.

revenueCurrency.description: Direct mode only. ISO 4217 code applied when the payload carries no currency.

webhookEvent.description: One of the values returned by GET .../source-options/stripe, for example charge.succeeded or charge.succeeded.first (first-ever payment by the customer). The source name is set from the event label.

accountFilter.description: Stripe account ids (acct_...) connected to this business. Omitted, null or empty means every connected account. An account not connected to this business is a 400.

productFilter.description: Stripe product ids (prod_...). Omitted, null or empty means every product.

formId.description: The Typeform form id (see GET .../source-options/typeform). Registers a webhook on the form and names the source "Typeform - <form title>".

fieldMappings.description: Optional Typeform-side field mappings, stored on the form record.

qualificationRules.description: Stored on this source; the form record is only a legacy fallback.

ghlConnectionId.description: Which connected sub-account. Omitted means the primary connection (see GET .../source-options/ghl).

formId.description: FormSubmitted: the GoHighLevel form id. Names are resolved server-side; an unknown id is a 400.

calendarIds.description: AppointmentCreate / AppointmentUpdate: calendar ids. Omitted or empty means every calendar.

stageIds.description: OpportunityStageUpdate: required, at least one stage in that pipeline.

trackRevenue.description: Opportunity events: record the opportunity value as revenue.

dedupOneEntryPerStage.description: OpportunityStageUpdate: one conversion per opportunity and stage; re-entries collapse.

currency.description: Opportunity events with trackRevenue: ISO 4217 code. Unknown codes fall back to USD.

qualificationRules.description: FormSubmitted, SurveySubmitted, AppointmentCreate, AppointmentUpdate: stored on the source and evaluated at ingest.

UpdateWebhookSource.title: Webhook source
UpdateWebhookSource.description: fieldMappings or mode replace the stored mapping in full.

UpdateStripeSource.title: Stripe source
UpdateStripeSource.description: Merge patch over the stored event and filters: an omitted filter is kept, null clears it.

UpdateGhlSource.title: GoHighLevel source

ghlConnectionId.description: Which connected sub-account. Omitted means the primary connection (see GET .../source-options/ghl).

formId.description: FormSubmitted: the GoHighLevel form id. Names are resolved server-side; an unknown id is a 400.

calendarIds.description: AppointmentCreate / AppointmentUpdate: calendar ids. Omitted or empty means every calendar.

stageIds.description: OpportunityStageUpdate: required, at least one stage in that pipeline.

trackRevenue.description: Opportunity events: record the opportunity value as revenue.

dedupOneEntryPerStage.description: OpportunityStageUpdate: one conversion per opportunity and stage; re-entries collapse.

currency.description: Opportunity events with trackRevenue: ISO 4217 code. Unknown codes fall back to USD.

UpdateGhlSource.description: Merge patch over the stored event: omitted fields are kept, then the event is re-validated and the source renamed as on create.

UpdateBasicSource.title: Any other source type
UpdateBasicSource.description: Sources created from the dashboard for other integrations accept name and isActive only.

ConversionSourceOptions.description: Shape depends on the integration. stripe: events[] and accounts[]. typeform: connected and forms[]. ghl: connected, connections[], eventTypes[], appointmentStatuses[], opportunityStatuses[], forms[], surveys[], calendars[], pipelines[] (with stages[]), products[]. close: connected, eventTypes[], forms[], pipelines[] (with statuses[]). shopify: connected, authMode (oauth or manual), shopDomain, events[] (topic, displayName, eventType, sourceType, requiresPlus) and usedTopics[] (which topics already feed a conversion, and which). woocommerce: connected, connections[] (stores), events[], orderStatuses[] (with recommended), defaultStatusFilter[], pixelEvents[]. clickfunnels: connected, connections[], events[] (with supportsProductFilter, requiresStageFilter, supportsPipelineFilter, supportsFunnelFilter), dedupWindowSeconds bounds, and with ?connectionId= also products[], pipelines[] (with stages[]) and funnels[]. tally: connected and forms[] (refresh=true re-syncs). kajabi: connected, siteId, siteTitle, events[]. callrail: connected, accountName, companyName, events[] (with hasRevenue, supportsCallFilters). Other integrations: events[] (the accepted catalogue) plus connected and, for whop / fanbasis / calendly, connections[].

connections.description: ghl only: the connected sub-accounts and which is primary.

syncErrors.description: Present when refresh=true and a sync failed; the cached data is still returned.

QualificationRules.description: Lead-qualification rules, the same shape the dashboard stores. A conversion is recorded only when the rules pass. On update, null clears them.

id.description: Any stable id you choose for the rule.

fieldId.description: The field the rule reads (a form question id, a GHL custom field id, a Stripe payment field).

formId.description: FormSubmitted: the Close form id (see GET .../source-options/close). Names are resolved server-side.

pipelineId.description: OpportunityWon / OpportunityStageChange: the Close pipeline id.

statusIds.description: OpportunityWon: optional narrowing to these statuses (omitted = every won status). OpportunityStageChange: required, at least one status in that pipeline.

customActivityTypeId.description: CustomActivity: optional narrowing to one activity type. Omitted = every custom activity.

customActivityTypeName.description: CustomActivity: label for the activity type; Close exposes no mirror to resolve it from.

trackRevenue.description: Opportunity events: record the opportunity value as revenue.

UpdateCloseSource.title: Close source

formId.description: FormSubmitted: the Close form id (see GET .../source-options/close). Names are resolved server-side.

pipelineId.description: OpportunityWon / OpportunityStageChange: the Close pipeline id.

statusIds.description: OpportunityWon: optional narrowing to these statuses (omitted = every won status). OpportunityStageChange: required, at least one status in that pipeline.

customActivityTypeId.description: CustomActivity: optional narrowing to one activity type. Omitted = every custom activity.

customActivityTypeName.description: CustomActivity: label for the activity type; Close exposes no mirror to resolve it from.

trackRevenue.description: Opportunity events: record the opportunity value as revenue.

UpdateCloseSource.description: Merge patch over the stored event: omitted fields are kept, then the event is re-validated and the source renamed as on create.

webhookEvent.description: From GET .../source-options/paypal, for example PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED or PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED.first (first payment Cortana has seen; PayPal cannot verify prior purchases).

accountFilter.description: PayPal merchant ids; omitted or null = every account.

UpdatePayPalSource.title: PayPal source
UpdatePayPalSource.description: Merge patch over the stored configuration; omitted fields are kept and the source is re-validated and renamed as on create.

CreateWhopSource.title: Whop source

whopConnectionId.description: Which Whop connection (GET .../source-options/whop). May be omitted when the business has exactly one.

productFilter.description: Whop product ids; a filtered source shares its webhook with the unfiltered one.

CreateWhopSource.description: Creating a Whop source switches conversions on for an ads-only connection and registers a webhook for the event on a best-effort basis, exactly as the dashboard does.

UpdateWhopSource.title: Whop source
UpdateWhopSource.description: Merge patch over the stored configuration; omitted fields are kept and the source is re-validated and renamed as on create.

fanbasisConnectionId.description: Which Fanbasis connection (GET .../source-options/fanbasis). May be omitted when the business has exactly one.

webhookEvent.description: A conversion-eligible Fanbasis event, for example payment.succeeded, payment.succeeded.first, payment.refunded, subscription.created.

productFilter.description: Only on events that support it.

UpdateFanbasisSource.title: Fanbasis source
UpdateFanbasisSource.description: Merge patch over the stored configuration; omitted fields are kept and the source is re-validated and renamed as on create.

eventTypeUris.description: The Calendly event types (calendars) to track. A calendar can be tracked once per event across the business.

calendlyConnectionId.description: Which Calendly account (GET .../source-options/calendly). May be omitted when the business has exactly one; required otherwise.

UpdateCalendlySource.title: Calendly source
UpdateCalendlySource.description: Merge patch over the stored configuration; omitted fields are kept and the source is re-validated and renamed as on create.

eventTypeId.description: Optional Cal.com event type id; omitted = every event type. One source per event + event type across the business.

UpdateCalComSource.title: CalCom source
UpdateCalComSource.description: Merge patch over the stored configuration; omitted fields are kept and the source is re-validated and renamed as on create.

UpdateFathomSource.title: Fathom source
UpdateFathomSource.description: Merge patch over the stored configuration; omitted fields are kept and the source is re-validated and renamed as on create.

CreateHubSpotSource.title: HubSpot source
CreateHubSpotSource.description: Ids and names come from your HubSpot portal; Cortana does not mirror them.

UpdateHubSpotSource.title: HubSpot source
UpdateHubSpotSource.description: Merge patch over the stored configuration; omitted fields are kept and the source is re-validated and renamed as on create.

CreateSalesforceSource.title: Salesforce source

statusValues.description: LeadStageChange: Lead.Status values (required). CampaignMemberStatus: CampaignMember.Status values (optional).

revenueField.description: Opportunity-backed events only: the Opportunity API field to read the value from. Omit for the standard Amount.

revenueDisabled.description: Opportunity-backed events only: record no revenue.

CreateSalesforceSource.description: LeadStageChange is refused when the Salesforce org is not recording Lead.Status history, because such a source could never fire. Update changes the revenue mapping only.

UpdateSalesforceSource.title: Salesforce source

revenueField.description: Omit or empty to go back to Amount.

UpdateSalesforceSource.description: Merge patch over the stored configuration; omitted fields are kept and the source is re-validated and renamed as on create.

CreateIClosedSource.title: IClosed source

iClosedEventIds.description: call.booked and Lead Generated: calendar or funnel ids; empty = all.

iClosedOutcomes.description: call.outcome_added: outcome allow-list (WON, NO_SALE, ...); empty = all.

trackRevenue.description: call.outcome_added: store the closed deal value as revenue.

CreateIClosedSource.description: The event is locked on update; filters are replaced wholesale.

UpdateIClosedSource.title: IClosed source
UpdateIClosedSource.description: Merge patch over the stored configuration; omitted fields are kept and the source is re-validated and renamed as on create.

UpdateShopierSource.title: Shopier source
UpdateShopierSource.description: Merge patch over the stored configuration; omitted fields are kept and the source is re-validated and renamed as on create.

CreateShopifySource.title: Shopify source

sourceType.description: SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK for server-side topics (orders/paid, checkouts/create, ...), SHOPIFY_PIXEL for storefront pixel topics (product_viewed, product_added_to_cart). Each topic belongs to one of the two; GET .../source-options/shopify lists the sourceType per topic and a mismatch is a 400.

webhookTopic.description: A Shopify topic from the catalogue: product_viewed, product_added_to_cart, carts/create, carts/update, checkouts/create, checkouts/update, checkouts/delete, orders/create, orders/paid, orders/fulfilled, orders/cancelled, refunds/create. carts/* need Shopify Plus (403 otherwise).

CreateShopifySource.description: One topic feeds one conversion, business-wide (409 names the conversion that already tracks it). For a shop connected through OAuth the webhook is registered in Shopify before the source is created; a manual-install shop registers webhook topics through the dashboard's prepare and test-event steps and gets a 400 here, while pixel topics work for both. Deleting the source removes the Shopify webhook.

UpdateShopifySource.title: Shopify source
UpdateShopifySource.description: Shopify sources accept name and isActive only.

CreateWooCommerceSource.title: WooCommerce order source

connectionId.description: Which connected store (GET .../source-options/woocommerce lists them). The source listens to that store only.

statusFilter.description: Order statuses that count (processing, completed, on-hold, ...; custom plugin statuses allowed). Omitted means the legacy ingestion gate applies. GET .../source-options/woocommerce lists the statuses and the recommended default.

CreateWooCommerceSource.description: The same event for the same store may feed a conversion once (409). The source is named after the event and the store.

UpdateWooCommerceSource.title: WooCommerce order source

statusFilter.description: Replaces the order-status allow-list; at least one status.

UpdateWooCommerceSource.description: The event and store are fixed.

pixelEvent.description: A storefront event fired by the tracking pixel on the connected store.

UpdateWooCommercePixelSource.title: WooCommerce pixel source
UpdateWooCommercePixelSource.description: WooCommerce pixel sources accept name and isActive only.

CreateClickFunnelsSource.title: ClickFunnels source

clickFunnelsConnectionId.description: Which workspace connection (GET .../source-options/clickfunnels lists them). A connection of another business is a 404.

webhookEvent.description: A ClickFunnels 2.0 event type: form_submission.created, appointments/scheduled_event.created, sales/opportunity.moved_stage, sales/opportunity.closed, one-time-order.completed, one-time-order.invoice.paid, subscription.first_payment_received, subscription.activated, subscription.trial_started, subscription.trial_converted, subscription.invoice.paid, orders/invoice.paid. The catalogue carries which filters each supports.

productFilter.description: ClickFunnels product ids for order and subscription events; null or omitted means every product.

pipelineId.description: Required for sales/opportunity.moved_stage; optional scope for sales/opportunity.closed.

funnelIds.description: form_submission.created only: accept submissions from these funnels; empty means any funnel.

dedupWindowSeconds.description: Seconds within which a repeat for the same contact is skipped. 30 to 90 days; default 30.

CreateClickFunnelsSource.description: The workspace's webhook endpoint is subscribed to the event before the source is created (502 if ClickFunnels refuses). The exact same source (event, connection, filters) may exist once per conversion (409). Use GET .../source-options/clickfunnels?connectionId=... to list the workspace's products, pipelines with stages, and funnels.

UpdateClickFunnelsSource.title: ClickFunnels source

productFilter.description: ClickFunnels product ids for order and subscription events; null or omitted means every product.

pipelineId.description: Required for sales/opportunity.moved_stage; optional scope for sales/opportunity.closed.

funnelIds.description: form_submission.created only: accept submissions from these funnels; empty means any funnel.

dedupWindowSeconds.description: Seconds within which a repeat for the same contact is skipped. 30 to 90 days; default 30.

UpdateClickFunnelsSource.description: A merge: an omitted filter is kept, null clears it. The event and connection are fixed. The name is rebuilt from the event, workspace and filters unless a name is sent.

CreateTallySource.title: Tally source

formId.description: The Tally form id (GET .../source-options/tally lists them).

fieldMappings.description: Tally-side field mappings stored on the form record; omitted keeps the form's current mappings.

CreateTallySource.description: Registers a webhook for the form in Tally before the source is created (502 if Tally refuses) and marks the form selected. One source per form per conversion (409). The source is named after the form.

qualificationRules.description: Replaces the rules on this source; null clears them.

CreateKajabiSource.title: Kajabi source

sourceType.description: API type only: the source is stored as a WEBHOOK row carrying a Kajabi marker, exactly as the dashboard stores it, and the response shows sourceType WEBHOOK.

name.description: Defaults to the event's standard name (Kajabi Purchase, Kajabi Payment, Kajabi Order, Kajabi Form Submission).

CreateKajabiSource.description: Registers the matching wildcard hook in Kajabi (every offer, now and later). Idempotent per conversion and name: a repeat call reuses the source and its hook URL. A rejected Kajabi key is a 400 asking for a reconnect. Once created the source updates like a webhook source.

UpdateKajabiSource.title: Kajabi source
UpdateKajabiSource.description: Stored as a WEBHOOK row, so it accepts the webhook source update body.

CreateCallRailSource.title: CallRail source

eventType.description: call_completed is Phone Call, call_good_lead is Call marked as Good Lead, form_submission is Form Submission (CallRail's own names).

name.description: Defaults to CallRail followed by the trigger's label.

trackRevenue.description: Phone Call and Good Lead only: record the call's value field as revenue. Default false.

currency.description: With trackRevenue; unknown codes fall back to USD.

CreateCallRailSource.description: The source's receiver URL is installed into the company's CallRail Webhooks integration in the same request; the source is created inactive and activated only after the install succeeds (502 with CallRail's reason otherwise, nothing left behind).

UpdateCallRailSource.title: CallRail source

isActive.description: false unsubscribes the receiver URL from CallRail (best-effort), true re-installs it.

trackRevenue.description: Phone Call and Good Lead only: record the call's value field as revenue. Default false.

currency.description: With trackRevenue; unknown codes fall back to USD.

UpdateCallRailSource.description: Settings are editable; the trigger is fixed. A trackRevenue change re-subscribes with the right CallRail event set. Delete unsubscribes first, then removes the source.

error.message: Too many requests. Retry after the reset window.

Forbidden.description: The caller may not perform this action on this resource

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource (for example a duplicate name, or a delete that needs confirmation)
